description: This file defines a Pagination controller class for the Opencart e-commerce platform, responsible for generating pagination navigation HTML based on provided settings such as total items, current page, items per page, and URL template.

classes.name: Pagination
classes.description: A controller class in the Opencart platform responsible for rendering pagination controls based on given settings.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates pagination links based on total items, current page, limit, and URL template, returning the HTML view or an empty string if no pagination is needed.
